Title: Verify Administrator can see all pricing and financial data on a work order
Preconditions:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has the See Financial Data permission ON).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
Steps:
1. Click Work Orders in the main navigation.
2. Open any work order from the list.
3. Look at the price field on each work order line.
4. Look at the Total, Labor, and Parts columns for the work order.
5. Open the Finance card on the work order.
6. Open the Stats tab of the work order.
Expected Result:
1. The Work Orders list opens and shows work orders.
2. The work order opens.
3. Every line price shows an actual dollar amount (not blank or masked).
4. The Total, Labor, and Parts columns show dollar amounts.
5. The Finance card shows invoice/payment totals.
6. The Stats tab shows financial figures. No money value is hidden anywhere on the work order.
